item.title: pstack — A Skill Pack for AI Coding Agents
item.description: Notes on pstack, the skill pack poteto (Lauren Tan) at Cursor published for AI coding agents. It is not a code library but a set of written instructions agents follow. What is in the repo, poteto-mode, the principle skills, unslop, and what changes in Claude Code.

item.title: Saving Tokens in Claude Code — Measured
item.description: I measured common Claude Code token-saving tips with claude -p: CLAUDE.md length, how you hand over logs, clearing sessions, model and effort, MCP tools, and subagents.
